meta.note: Original system for a personal portfolio; no codebase source.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm graphite paper in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: project cards, inputs, nav bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: code samples, image placeholders, input track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, tags, ghost buttons). 3.4:1+ on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The dot/plus grid and registration marks. Decoration, never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-sunk (14.7:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on bg, surface and surface-sunk (6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, active marker, cover block. A fill, not a text colour; text on it is on-signal.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (5.6:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text: section indices, links, the focus ring. 4.7:1+ on bg, surface, surface-sunk and signal-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an active tag or a highlighted line; text on it is signal-text.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: "Available" status text and dot on bg, surface and live-soft (5:1+ both themes). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the live status pill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name or statement, once per page.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section titles beside a SectionHeader index.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Two-digit section and project numbers, in signal-text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase metadata labels, nav links, tags, buttons.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline and block code, coordinates, timestamps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding; card inner rhythm.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter; dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between cards stacked vertically on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, nav, the cover blocks. The default: this system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags: just enough to soften the pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots only. Nothing else is round.

shadow.note: No soft shadows. Elevation is a hard offset, shown only on hover/press.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Hover state of ProjectCard and primary Button: element moves -2px,-2px and gains this offset.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: columns
tokens.usage: Desktop column count; 4 under 720px.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter, equals space-6.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body text.
